## CrowdStrike Called Overvalued Following 4.6x Three-Year Price Run

Valuation-driven caution on CRWD after a major multi-year run is relevant for position sizing; the critical distinction is between valuation risk (timing) and thesis risk (fundamentals) — if the competitive position remains intact, this is a trimming signal, not an exit.

- A Simply Wall St piece argues CRWD is overvalued after appreciating 4.6x over three years.
- The concern is valuation multiple stretch, not operational or competitive deterioration.
